name: Ekechukwuemeka Charles Xavier
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Cybersecurity practitioner, technology strategist, and fractional CTO. Xavier founded CAXiE Technologies with a mandate to deliver enterprise-grade technology to organisations that had been underserved by generic IT solutions. He leads every major client engagement personally and currently serves as incoming fractional CTO for 3StarData.
